changeSet.author: workflow
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE wf.workflow_task ADD assignment_kind VARCHAR(5) NULL, assignment_ref NVARCHAR(200) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 NULL;
UPDATE wf.workflow_task SET assignment_kind = 'USER', assignment_ref = assigned_user_ref;

IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf.workflow_task WHERE assignment_kind IS NULL OR assignment_kind <> 'USER' OR assignment_ref IS NULL OR assignment_ref <> assigned_user_ref OR DATALENGTH(assignment_ref) <> DATALENGTH(assigned_user_ref)) THROW 51000, 'Task assignment backfill validation failed', 1;
